title: React Component Library workbench UI manifest
description: Declares the library-owned AppShell adapter and scenario-owned workbench placement slot.

page.description: Routed workbench pages mounted beneath the AppShell adapter.

feature.description: A workbench feature directory, such as component, studio, or search.

feature-component.description: A component module directly inside the selected workbench feature directory.

layout-shell.description: Scenario adapter that composes the library AppShell with RCL's authoring navigation, utilities, and routed workspace content.
